description: This file contains test cases for the Wishlist API endpoints in a Django REST Framework project. It verifies authentication requirements, idempotent behaviors for adding/removing items, and user scoping of wishlist data.

methods.name: test_wishlist_requires_auth(api_client)
methods.description: Tests that accessing the wishlist API requires authentication.

methods.name: test_wishlist_add_list_remove_idempotent( api_client, item_factory, auth_headers_for_user )
methods.description: Tests adding an item to the wishlist, ensures idempotence of add/remove operations, and verifies listing includes the item.

methods.name: test_wishlist_user_scoped( api_client, item_factory, obtain_jwt_tokens, user, user_password )
methods.description: Ensures that wishlist data is scoped per user and that a user cannot see another user's wishlist.
